## Month Totals

Set `month`; `fromDate` and `toDate` are its first and last day. Each kind of document is its own query: `bills` (posted Bills dated in the month), `openings` (posted Opening Balances), `invoices` (posted Invoices) and `journal` (the Journal Month for the month). `totals` (`AccountTotal`: `account`, `debitMinor`, `creditMinor`, an internal output shape) sums every `ledgerLines` entry across all of them, per account.

Also computed: `billCount`, `paymentCount` (bill-payment postings), `postingCount`, `documentCount` (invoices), `debitMinor`, `creditMinor` and `balanced`. The page notes when a query returned only part of its matches.

```ts
import { MonthTotals } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-months';
```

### Operations
- `issue`: creates a draft Month Close for this month carrying the given `totals` as stored fields. Month Close's `post` then checks they balance.

### Non-goals
This card re-adds every document each time it renders; reports over many months read Month Close instead. A new kind of document needs its own relationship here.

### Example
`Month/2025-12`, the month holding the opening bills.
